pairDeltaCandidates.name: DELTA_SUPPORT_TRIANGLE

pairDeltaCandidates.name: DELTA_PARITY_TRIANGLE
pairDeltaCandidates.definition: Retain only token coordinates whose signed integer delta has odd magnitude; discard sign and exact magnitude.

pairDeltaCandidates.name: DELTA_SIGN_TRIANGLE

pairDeltaCandidates.name: DELTA_ABS_MAG_TRIANGLE

pairDeltaCandidates.name: DELTA_SIGNED_CLIPPED_MAG_TRIANGLE

pairDeltaCandidates.name: DELTA_EXACT_TRIANGLE
